agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
March 5, 2025 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Non-Public Hearing Agenda Items. Persons
  wishing to address the Planning Commission on any item on the
  agenda other than a public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A continued public hearing to consider an application by Chima
  Chibueze representing the Tribe for a Special Use Permit No. 24-
  00027 (SUP24-00027) to allow hookah within an existing nightclub
  on an approximately 34,600 square-foot, MU-1 (TOD Mixed Use-1)
  zoned property at 446 South Market Street.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2025-001;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP24-00027.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 5a Documents

6.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Real Estate
  Development Services Group for Final Tract Map No. 84423 (FTM-
  84423) to allow the subdivision of air rights for the
  development of five units, two-and-one-half-story, townhome-
  style condominiums on an approximately 8,006 square-foot R-3
  (Multiple-family Residential) zoned property at 419 South
  Eucalyptus Avenue.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Adopt the resolution recommending approval of FTM-84423
  by the Mayor and City Council; and
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and make the findings.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A non-public hearing to consider a Design Review application by
  Vlad Arutyunyan to allow the construction of a new approximately
  28,760 square-foot four-story medical office building on an
  approximately 21,900 square-foot C-2 (General Commercial)/Art
  Deco Overlay zoned property at 3200-3216 West Manchester
  Boulevard.
   Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2025-021;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving DR24-00065.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6b Documents

7.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

8.  Commission Initiatives.

9.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of March 5, 2025, is
not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item
being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item
will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY,APRIL 2,2025 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
